reviews.text: They are all brilliant at Virtue Vets with marvellous, sympathetic and knowledgable vets, great nursing and admistrative staff with all our Virtue Vets visits providing a great relief to both our sometimes ailing King Charles Cavalier, Poppy Poppy and to us!

We were so pleased to find out that Virtue Vets offers hydrotherapy right in the heart of Chelsea! Our rescue dog Piccolina is only 4.5, but was diagnosed earlier this year with severe arthritis in her elbows and hips. I was really worried about what that diagnosis could mean for her and how much it might limit her life, especially at such a young age.

Piccolina is also a rescue and can be nervous, so I was apprehensive about whether hydrotherapy would even work for her in case she hated it. Danielle our physiotherapist was very patient with her from the beginning, taking everything at Piccolina’s pace. Fast forward nine weeks and Piccolina now pulls me down the road when she realises we’re heading to her hydrotherapy session!

We've been combining hydrotherapy, laser and physio, alongside exercises we do at home. The difference we’re seeing has been so encouraging, and hydrotherapy in particular is helping Piccolina build her muscles to support her joints and, most importantly for us, keep enjoying her life.

I also love that Virtue Vets invests in technology to support the dogs they treat. Piccolina recently got to try their new Tendiboots, which provide real-time gait analysis via little sensors on the paws. Seeing her results was fascinating, and it gives objective data to monitor Piccolina and adapt her treatment. The boots can even be worn in the hydrotherapy treadmill, which we’re looking forward to trying next!

Danielle and all the physiotherapists have been wonderful with Piccolina, and after seeing how she is progressing, hydrotherapy and laser have become non-negotiables for us, Thank you!

Sadly, I lost confidence in my dog's care.

I am genuinely sorry to leave this review, as I came to Virtue with high hopes after following a vet I had previously trusted. Unfortunately, after a series of experiences involving my elderly dog, who has several more complex health issues, I have decided to return to my previous veterinary practice.
My experience has left me feeling that Virtue may be better suited to the more routine aspects of veterinary care than to the type of complex, multi-disciplinary investigation my dog ultimately required. A number of specialist opinions during his care were obtained remotely or through external providers, and I found the resulting experience fragmented. I particularly missed being able to have meaningful conversations directly with the relevant specialists about findings, options and clinical reasoning.
More seriously, during one procedure my dog was admitted for radiographs under sedation. The sedation was insufficient, an additional anaesthetic drug was administered, he developed respiratory depression, was intubated and the procedure continued under general anaesthesia. I was not told at discharge that he had been intubated or had undergone general anaesthesia. I discovered this later from his clinical records. Virtue subsequently acknowledged to me that this should have been communicated and also acknowledged deficiencies in the associated anaesthetic documentation.
There were other aspects of his clinical journey which concerned me, particularly around investigation of his chronic cough and the proposed management of a hindlimb injury. He subsequently underwent multidisciplinary assessment at the Royal Veterinary College, and I am much happier with the direction of his care now.
I have raised my concerns formally with the practice, and I think it is only fair to acknowledge that the Clinical Director engaged substantively with my complaint and accepted a number of shortcomings.
I am nevertheless deeply disappointed by the overall experience. For routine care, other clients may have a completely different experience. For my dog, however, I ultimately lost confidence in the management of his more complex needs and have returned to my previous veterinary practice.

Absolutely excellent veterinary care once again. The vets here are brilliant. Tara who saw our dog knew how to handle his fear issues and was able to proscribe the right medication for his ailment. Always welcoming and most importantly I am always reassured by their knowledge and understanding. Superb approach. Thank you 🙏

I can't recommend Dr. Mariya enough for her extremely kind, affectionate and considerate service. Dr. Mariya listened attentively and thoughtfully to the emergency circumstances around Pika a young scottish fold cat and offered her best care throughout, as well as tremendous patience as we worked through solutions together. She went above and beyond her duties and leads with lots of empathy.

The clinic is extremely transparent with their process, what care options they recommend and in explaining what's going on with any pet brought in sick so that the owner feels assured and knowledgable throughout the process. These guys run an excellent veterinary service in west london, do not hesitate to book!
I pop by in and Daniel was super friendly. Other staffs are very friendly too, the cat is very cute

It was by chance that I found out about virtue vet, after my bernese mountain dog had to do post surgery physio and hydro. Buddy has been doing continued progress with mobility and Virtue vet practitioners are all incredibly professional and talented. It is pricey, like everything in London but worth it. And they are very transparent on pricing structure which is welcome !

Absolutely brilliant service from start to finish. I took my nervous spaniel in for a routine check-up and the team were calm, kind and wonderfully reassuring. Everything was explained clearly, and we left feeling genuinely cared for. A proper five-star experience.

I’ve had a brilliant experience with this practice. My dog has undergone two IVDD surgeries, so finding the right ongoing care has been really important to me. I’ve been coming here for physiotherapy as well as routine vaccinations and general check ups. I couldn’t be happier with the support we’ve received.

All of the physiotherapists are incredibly kind, patient, and knowledgeable. They take the time to make sure my dog is comfortable and confident, and it really shows—he gets genuinely excited to come in, which says everything.

He’s been doing both hydrotherapy and red light therapy, and the progress he’s making has been fantastic. It’s such a relief to see him getting stronger and more mobile after everything he’s been through.

I’d highly recommend this practice to anyone looking for compassionate, professional care for their pet.

We are truly happy with Virtue Vets. The professionals are really talented, careful and humane, the team is friendly and helpful and he installations are state-of-the-art. It is exactly the kind of healthcare you expect for your beloved fur family member. Couldn't recommend it enough, especially vet Mariya.
fantastic hydrotherapy & physio for an older (11yrs) labrador.  great team.

I LOVE Virtue Vets, especially the physiotherapy team. My dog has kyphotic posture and twisted hind legs, and they do an amazing job with laser, massage, and hydrotherapy to help her maintain mobility, improve her posture, and ease pain. HIGHLY recommend them!

Absolutely excellent service. Complete care and trust. Cannot recommend highly enough. Wonderful team. They were able to fit me in.
Most importantly recommended to me by a local resident with an older dog with age related issues. Thank you 🙏 …
Such an amazing team, trust them so much with my dog!

The most welcoming vets in the area with the friendliest staff. So glad we chose this vet as we’ve just moved to the area. Athena gets all the treats and cuddles from the staff, you feel like they really care 😊 …

I’ve been bringing my miniature dachshund Ruby to Virtue Vets the Bolton’s location for awhile now and I can’t recommend them highly enough. This is actually my second review of the practice. The care and attention Ruby receives every single visit is exceptional. You can tell this team genuinely loves animals not just as their patients but as little personalities in their own right

What sets Virtue Vets apart though isn’t just the clinical care which is outstanding but the community they’ve built around it from Dog Pilates to Easter egg hunts and so many other brilliant get-togethers. They’ve created something really special for the owners too

It’s rare to find a vet practice that thinks about the whole experience from the great selection of drinks when you walk in, through to the genuine care for your beloved pet.

I highly recommend VV to any pet owner looking for a practice that truly cares and you feel a part of a fun community too

I honestly can’t say enough good things about this team. My two girls have been coming in for support and physical therapy, and the level of care they receive every single visit is outstanding.

From the moment we walk in, it’s clear how much everyone genuinely cares. They take the time to explain everything, tailor the therapy to each of my girls’ needs, and make sure they’re comfortable (and even enjoying it… most of the time!).

What really stands out is the combination of professionalism and kindness. You can tell they truly love what they do, and that makes all the difference.

If you’re looking for a place that treats your pets like their own while delivering top-tier care, this is it. Highly recommend.

Our mini dachshund Piero absolutely loves visiting, which says everything about the team here. Mariya, Jenny, and all the staff are wonderfully kind and incredibly attentive, making sure Piero is always comfortable and never scared. They are clearly experienced and well-prepared, but what really stands out is how much they genuinely care. They even check in after visits to see how he is doing. We are on a subscription and couldn’t be happier with the service. Highly recommend to any pet owner looking for a vet practice that truly goes above and beyond.

I highly, highly recommend Virtue Vets Chelsea The Boltons, especially Dr. Mariya.

She has been taking care of my dog Teresa since she was a puppy. This time, Teresa had her spaying surgery and everything was absolutely perfect. Teresa is a very anxious dog, but Dr. Mariya always handles her with so much care, patience and understanding. She truly knows how to manage her in a way that keeps both Teresa and me feeling safe and reassured.

Teresa recovered beautifully, with perfect healing and no issues at all. I’m so grateful to the entire team.

Teresa has actually been Dr. Mariya’s patient since a previous clinic, and we followed her here because we absolutely love and trust her. She also takes care of my other dog Tobias and my cat, and I genuinely would not trust anyone else with my pets.

I truly, truly recommend them.

Thank you so much for everything.
My dog has always been very nervous with vets - and she just loves all the vets at Virtue Vets - it’s just a very caring and professional environment.

This clinic is absolutely great and the staff are super helpful. One of their staff members, Alexandra gave me a tour and answered all of my questions. The location was very clean and well maintained and the staff seemed friendly. Overall it’s my favorite vet practice I’ve seen in London and is where I will be taking my pets.

Thank you so much Ninad and Sarah! Amazing care plan to help with my doggie's care for recovery. Virtue vets, is passionate and dedicated to helping my pet and her health. My doggie was in a lot of pain and in no time Virtue Vets helped with a care plan, I can not find the words to describe such an amazing , quality service and just being wonderful, friendly, kind and compassionate, My little doggie thanks you very much, she's now sleeping with a smile.
Excellent service and care for our dog! He’s made to feel quite comfortable each time!

I’m very conflicted writing this review because one of the practicing vets is excellent. She is knowledgeable, kind, thorough, and has fantastic bedside manner. She is absolutely someone I would have trusted with my dog for many years.

Unfortunately, my experience with VirtueVets as a practice was disappointing.

After two appointments close together for the same ongoing condition, the prescribed treatment was not working and my dog’s symptoms were worsening. I returned just two days later seeking help. Rather than adjusting the treatment plan, I was told I would need to pay another £75 consultation fee because I was seeing a different vet, despite it being the same clinic, with shared records, for an unresolved condition.

The second vet I saw was unkind and lacked empathy during what was already a stressful situation. I found this especially surprising given VirtueVets’ positioning as a modern, reputable franchise.

The overall structure felt rigid, expensive, and more focused on repeat fees than continuity of care. I thought this review may help when others are choosing a vet in the local area.

The team took wonderful care of my cat, Lua. She went in to be spayed and I was quite nervous for her. Everyone was very friendly and kind and I knew she was is safe hands. She is home now and very happy. Thank you all!
Fabulous care and service from Tara and Alexandra. They looked after our mini dachshund superly. Can recommend highly!

I cannot recommend Virtue Vets highly enough. It is a super calm and friendly environment for both pets and owners! Jenny and her team have overseen the care of our dog with compassion and kindness. She is incredibly knowledgeable and communicates this in a professional and gentle manner. We are super grateful for the care our dog has received over the last few months.

Simply amazing. I was absolutely impressed with the clinic and phisio assessment today.
The place is stunning, smells like a spa. Billy the phisio is an absolute star. He s.caring, knowledgeable, friendly and understands dogs as nobody else.
Mia had her treatment today, even went to the water for hydrotherapy!
What a treatment! I am over the moon.
Mia will undergo a plan for her condition and I am absolutely reassured this will give her longevity and quality of life.
Thank you Billy. You are an incredible human being being.
Such a lovely team and a beautiful clinic. The vets are incredibly knowledgeable and always understanding of each patient’s needs!
Best vet in London (especially for shibas). Really appreciate our Norwegian vet, Sol 🙏 …

Virtue Vets is great value for premium care. They have state of the art equipment, a beautiful clinic, a straightforward plan and made switching so easy. The team are extremely knowledgeable and caring. Angel is a much happier and healthier cat especially after removing an infected tooth that was only picked up when we switched . Thank you for providing next level vet care to Angel.

Robert, our senior pug, recently had dental treatment at Virtue Vets with Gia. We were quite worried about how he’d cope with the sedation and tooth extraction at his age, but Gia handled everything perfectly. She kept us updated, looked after Robert all day, and talked us through every step of his aftercare. The clinic also is absolutely stunning inside.

Thank you for the incredible care you gave to our little boy.

My nearly 16 year old deaf dog Maude has been going to virtue vets for hydrotherapy and physio every week for the last month. The whole experience is incredible from start to finish every time we visit, but I have to give huge shoutout to Jackie who is incredible.

Jackie has taken Maude from barely being able to walk from weakness, stiffness and muscle soreness caused by a neurological condition to us not really being able to stop her bouncing around most days. She also took the time to learn Maude’s sign language and she makes every visit educational for us too, helping us improve and adjust Maude’s at home physio and recovery as needed!

The results speak for themselves, but excellent standard of care Jackie gives is second to none

Absolutely fantastic experience with the lovely people at this amazing new clinic.
Super friendly, knowledgable and professional. The clinic is state of the art with incredible equipment. Absolutely recommend.

My cat Sasha received outstanding care with Virtue Vets Boltons. The vet Jenny demonstrated exceptional kindness, compassion and professionalism throughout the visit, making Sasha feel calm and well looked after. I was very impressed by the level of expertise and attention and I’ll definitely continue bringing Sasha here. They even have a room dedicated for cats.
Highly recommended.
